## File: facebookresearch_beanmachine/website/scripts/convert_ipynb_to_mdx.py

Prompts

```
['convert a Jupyter notebook file to MDX format for Docusaurus documentation site', 'handle markdown cell images by updating paths and copying them to the assets folder', 'transform Bokeh plot outputs from notebook cells into MDX with saved JSON data files', 'aggregate and prioritize different cell output types like images, plots, and plain text', 'create MDX frontmatter metadata from notebook tutorial configuration including title and sidebar label']
```

Usage

```
{'convert_notebook_to_mdx': 'convert a Jupyter notebook file to MDX format for Docusaurus documentation site', 'handle_markdown_cell_images': 'handle markdown cell images by updating paths and copying them to the assets folder', 'transform_bokeh_outputs': 'transform Bokeh plot outputs from notebook cells into MDX with saved JSON data files', 'aggregate_cell_outputs': 'aggregate and prioritize different cell output types like images, plots, and plain text', 'create_mdx_frontmatter': 'create MDX frontmatter metadata from notebook tutorial configuration including title and sidebar label'}
```
